## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a7da5b921b3b7f8909440d0547bd4b10436ca0f6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + references/seat-lifecycle.md L30, references/project-forms.md L27 and L35–L38, references/rest-channel.md L10 and L47–L49, references/review-checklist.md (77/77), references/triage-duties.md (byte-identical to `main`), SKILL.md L45 and L198, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS rows L409, L538, L1287; MAX_LINE_BYTES L2358; MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES rows), .claude/agents/os-dev.md L62–L65 and L322–L323, .github/workflows/lint.yml (gate-to-job mapping), and the merge-tree readings against `origin/main` `4c8f40a1961f75b84d5f2222554c471e035a3744`

Record written 2026-10-23T17:00Z by an isolated reviewer of the `domain:skills` seat 2 session, on head `a7da5b92` (the third commit of PR #25474: content commit `5ea4c1cc83`, then two merges of `origin/main`). Inputs: card #25457 (its body quotes the maintainer's words of 2026-10-23T14:43Z), the seat claim (comment 6368326080), PR #25474 (body, file list, net diff against `origin/main` at `4c8f40a196`), the head's check-runs; also the prior record 6368204690 ③-1 on #25427 (the `coordinator.md` wording it suggested) and the ruling 6363872862 on #25379 (item 1A, which fixed `dispatch-runbook.md` L141–L142). The PR body's self-assessment was not trusted; every reading below was re-derived with read-only git on the committed tree, no checkout, no gate re-run. Angle brackets are written as 〈 〉 so the sanitizer keeps them.

### ① Derived judgments

**Surface.** `git diff --name-only origin/main..a7da5b92`: exactly the four files above, +8 −6, all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. No Tier H path (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, CODEOWNERS), no `scripts/**`, no `.claude/settings.json`, `SKILL.md` untouched (318 lines). `references/triage-duties.md` is byte-identical to `main` (`git diff` empty), so the human floor is untouched. The merge-base with `origin/main` is `origin/main` itself: the branch already contains #25422 (`5497d4ad43`) and #25427 (`ea33919f56`), the two serial constraints the card and claim name, and the check-runs ran on the merged tree. Correct.

**1. Wanted 1 — `execution-duties.md` L129–L131 (old L130 → three lines, 117 / 111 / 112 bytes).** Old: 「派发令恒带 `Writes:` 行:只走 REST 代理、写预算(端点清单)、`mcp_calls` 计数,dev 两数都报。」 New: 「派发令恒带 `Writes:` 行:PR 只经中继 `pr_create`;评论/标签/正文只经中继写工具;两数都报。」 / 「⛔ GitHub MCP 写:`create_pull_request`、`update_pull_request`、`issue_write`、`add_issue_comment` 等。」 / 「多仓项目线程不加载仓 `settings.json` deny,此行即唯一防线;两数 = 写预算与 `mcp_calls`。」 Against the card's Wanted 1: PR only through the relay's `pr_create` — carried; comments, labels, body edits only through the relay write tools — carried as the class 「中继写工具」 rather than the card's three script names (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`); those names already stand where the dev is sent for the spelling (`rest-channel.md` L47–L49, `landing-operations.md` L52, `seat-post-protocol.md` L30, `lanes/ui.md` L23), and `pr_create` resolves through SKILL.md L198 and `execution-duties.md` L59, so the rule is operative without them; ⛔ GitHub MCP writes by name — the card's four names carried, its 「…」 carried as 「等」; the one clause on the multi-repo project not loading the repo `settings.json` deny, so this line is the guard — carried verbatim in meaning. Both counts kept and now defined (「两数 = 写预算与 `mcp_calls`」). Dropped from the old line: 「只走 REST 代理」 (subsumed: the relay is that proxy, `rest-channel.md` L10) and the parenthetical 「(端点清单)」, whose detail still stands at the dev's own rule, `os-dev.md` L65 「报告记 `api_writes`(次数 + 端点清单)与 `mcp_calls`」. Correct.

**2. The payment — `execution-duties.md` old L121–L122 merged into new L121 (120 bytes, the widest line of the diff).** Old: 「派发词 ⛔ 默认不整段粘贴 issue 正文:让 dev 自己读全文与全部评论并自查正文完整性。」 and 「派发词只带增量,构造细则与条款原文见 `references/dispatch-runbook.md`。」 New: 「派发词只带增量,⛔ 不整段粘贴卡正文(dev 自读全文与评论);构造细则见 `dispatch-runbook.md`。」 Kept: increments only; ⛔ no whole-body paste; the dev reads the full text and every comment; the pointer to the runbook (whose own L3 says it holds 「参数、模板、步骤与原文」, so 「条款原文见」→「构造细则见」 still resolves). 「默认」 is gone, which makes the no-paste rule absolute; the verbatim-quotation allowance it covered survives on the very next line, L122 「派发词引卡片的精确断言(schema 臂、判据、原文)一律逐字」, so no exception is lost. Lost: 「并自查正文完整性」 — the dev's own check that the body it read is whole. The PR body reports it; it is a clause, not a tail, and a 116-byte spelling keeps it (③-1). Judged: the merge pays the line without losing either of the two rules the card asks to keep; one sub-clause is dropped and flagged, non-blocking.

**3. Wanted 2 — `dispatch-runbook.md` L140 in place (119 bytes).** Old: 「派发令由 coordinator 写进卡线程开场消息,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上派发评论留一行指针。」 New: 「派发令由 coordinator 写进线程开场消息,`Writes:` 行逐字在内,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上留指针。」 The card's 「carries that `Writes:` line verbatim」 is carried as 「`Writes:` 行逐字在内」. 「卡线程开场消息」→「线程开场消息」 keeps its referent (the line sits in 〈卡线程(`mode:thread`)〉); 「卡上派发评论留一行指针」→「卡上留指针」 keeps the pointer comment. Ruling 1A on #25379 fixed the shape of L141–L142 (coordinator reads the branch, the seat claims, the thread verifies): both lines are byte-identical to `main` on this head. Correct.

**4. Wanted 3 — `contract-review.md` L29 (+1, 116 bytes), placed right after the ①②③ item line in 〈复核归属与资格〉.** 「另记作者:PR `user.login` 非 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` ⇒ ③ 注点名该 login(脱中继写),落地前读。」 Names the ③ note, the login to record, the reason (an off-relay write) and the reading moment (before landing) — the card's Wanted 3 whole. Placed in `contract-review.md` (54 → 55 of 60 on this head) rather than `review-checklist.md` (77/77, no headroom) — the card allowed either. `objectstack-fleet[bot]` is the bot login the card itself names and `rest-channel.md` L10 already carries; no personal login enters rule text: `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` on the head → no hit. No `#NNN` citation in any of the eight new lines (id-lint). Correct. The new line is applied to this very PR at ③-4.

**5. Scope addition — `coordinator.md` L12–L13 in place (119 and 117 bytes).** Old: 「一条车道恒归一个项目:车道任一座位贴 🟢 标着另一项目 ⇒ 车道已有主,⛔ 不坐别席。」 / 「仲裁者是座位贴,⛔ 不是项目记忆;另一项目在飞卡由其席跟完,其收班简报在即可坐。」 New: 「一车道归一项目:座位贴 🟢 写他账号 ⇒ 车道已有主;仲裁者是座位贴,⛔ 不是项目记忆。」 / 「⛔ 不坐别席,另一项目在飞卡由其席跟完;维护者指令行改写 ⇒ 按 `project-forms.md` 接管。」 Agreement on `main`: `seat-lifecycle.md` L30 「维护者强制接管令取席位、队列、在飞卡、未起工卡与待落地 PR;⛔ 不等原认领者注记」 and `project-forms.md` L37–L38 「🟢 行写着别的账号 ⇒ 指令行即维护者强制接管令,含在飞卡」 / 「撞墙账号写不出任何东西,接管永不等它的注记或简报」. The clause that contradicted them, 「其收班简报在即可坐」 (sit once the closing brief is in), is gone; 「标着另一项目」→「写他账号」 reads the 🟢 line the way `project-forms.md` L37 does now that #25427 removed the project types; the no-order default (the other project's seat finishes its in-flight cards) is kept; the maintainer's rewrite of the instruction line is routed to `project-forms.md`, so the takeover mechanics live in one place. The claim's suggested L13 began with 「仲裁者是座位贴,⛔ 不是项目记忆;」; the PR moved that clause to L12 to fit the byte cap — same content, same two lines. `git diff origin/main..a7da5b92 -- references/coordinator.md` is −2 +2 on L12–L13; the other 47 lines are byte-identical. Correct; one residual wording note at ③-2.

**6. Acceptance reads on the head.** `git grep -n 'create_pull_request' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` → one hit, `execution-duties.md` L130, the ⛔ line: named only as forbidden. Budgets against the CEILINGS map (the PR does not touch the ratchet script): `execution-duties.md` 188/188 (row L1287), `dispatch-runbook.md` 241/241 (row L409), `contract-review.md` 55/60 (row L538), `coordinator.md` 49 lines net 0 — that file carries no CEILINGS row on `main` or on this head (`grep -n coordinator scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` → no hit; see ③-3). Every added or edited line measured 111–120 bytes against `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`; `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` for the four files is 0 and no table row is touched; no ceiling row moved or needed. No angle bracket in the new text.

**7. Merge.** `a7da5b92` has parents `c246fb07b1` and `4c8f40a196` (= `origin/main` at this review); `git merge-tree --write-tree` on those parents yields `0815ab01c9a7745e546668f69f173bcb486cf96c`, byte-identical to the merge commit's tree. `c246fb07b1` (parents `5ea4c1cc83` and `ea33919f56`, the #25427 merge) likewise reproduces its tree `5e83d1c4995b8de33fa54baed0a7ee580e26057c`. No hand-resolved conflict, nothing from `main` altered or dropped; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main a7da5b92` is clean.

**8. Gates — the head's check-runs are the record.** 35 check-runs on `a7da5b92`, all `completed`: 25 `success`, 10 `skipped`, none failed, none pending at the time of this write. The required floor `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are both `success`; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success`. The four gates the card names run inside `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`; `lint.yml` L1035, L1045) and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (`pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `check-skill-frame-freshness.mjs --self-test` + scan; L5516, L5554) — both `success`. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` only; no package `files[]` content moves, so nothing is published. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, the right form for this repo for a rules-only change; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the body match the diff. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Dropped sub-clause 「并自查正文完整性」 at `execution-duties.md` L121 (self-reported in the PR body).** A line-neutral 116-byte spelling keeps it: 「- 派发词只带增量,⛔ 不整段贴卡正文;dev 自读全文与评论、自查完整(`dispatch-runbook.md`)。」 Non-blocking; the seat's ACCEPT names whether it lands on this PR or as a one-line follow-up.
2. **`coordinator.md` L13 says 「维护者指令行改写 ⇒ …接管」; `project-forms.md` L27 says 「维护者在项目里写下或改写这一行,是唯一的指派动作」**, so a freshly written line (a new project) is also an order there. The pointer 「按 `project-forms.md` 接管」 resolves it in practice, and the claim's suggested text used the same word; 「写下或」 does not fit the cap (126 bytes). Recorded, no change demanded.
3. **PR body against the tree:** (a) 「`contract-review.md` 48 → 49, 49/60」 is the pre-#25422 count; on this head the file is 54 → 55 of 60. (b) 「`coordinator.md` 49/49 (ceiling 49)」 names a ceiling row that does not exist — the file is unmetered by the ratchet (a card for the seat if it is to be metered; not this PR's defect, the file is net 0). (c) The body says `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` derives no path mandate while the claim says 「MANDATORY」; not re-run here. The served tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` either way under `contract-review.md` 「档随面定:…governed 规则文本 ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`」. (d) The Gates paragraph was measured on `5ea4c1c`, two merges before this head; the head's check-runs above are the record, as the body itself says.
4. **Author line applied to this PR.** `user.login` on PR #25474 is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay write and no login note is owed under the new L29. The authoring account is read from the body's attribution block (`github_login` = `os-elon-musk`), per `contract-review.md` 「作者账户 = PR 正文 attribution 的 `github_login`」. That block is an HTML comment on the body's first line (`os-dev.md` L322 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text; the body reports it as a deviation) and puts `Fixes #25457` on the third line rather than the first (`review-checklist.md` 「正文首行引用卡片」) — the same shape #25422 and #25427 landed with; recorded, not a FAIL. The check 「The card this PR closes must claim this branch」 is `success`.
5. **Same-account review.** The implementing card thread (`claude/project-thread-4obil9`, session `session_01REirBR5H4pfZ96C61mK6Uj`), this isolated reviewer and the adopting seat session all run under `os-elon-musk`, the PR's attribution login. Under `contract-review.md` 「项目席落地的 Tier S:`Reviewed-by:` 须属 PR 作者外的账户;同账户子代理只算复核」 this record is the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and not the cross-account record; under the interim line 「过渡:无另一账户在席时,① 的替代 = 维护者本人在执行线程的话:逐个点名 PR 编号,或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)」 the maintainer's standing word in the seat thread of 2026-10-23T14:14Z 「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」 is the ① substitute. The queue guard reads the same.
6. **Check-runs completed before posting.** Four `Lint · …` jobs were still `in_progress` when the tree reading was taken; re-read until none pending: 35/35 completed, conclusions `success` or `skipped` only.
7. **Commit trailers.** The content commit `5ea4c1cc83` carries the model-free trailer pair and no card trailer; the card relation is the body's `Fixes` line only. The two merge commits are plain merges.

Independence: the diff was produced by the card thread on branch `claude/project-thread-4obil9`; this record is rendered by an isolated subagent and adopted by the `domain:skills` seat 2 session named below.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4obil9`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`
Reviewed-by-account: `os-elon-musk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `684b081ca82692002029b3106e91687722487e5a`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range a7da5b92..684b081c`, a read of the new commit's message only, to confirm its trailer pair carries no card relation and no model identifier (exit 0); no gate re-run, no checkout
Scope: delta `a7da5b92..684b081c` (.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md L121 only) + the PR body as it stands, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS row L1317, MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES row L2168), and the merge-tree reading against `origin/main` `915e9404992234a7cd0d2dd4701dfbadbe9cb2c7`

Delta record written 2026-10-23T17:08Z by an isolated reviewer of the `domain:skills` seat 2 session, on head `684b081c` (the fourth commit of PR #25474, a single-parent commit on `a7da5b92`). The prior record 6370282626 (2026-10-23T17:00Z, PASS on `a7da5b92`) is carried forward by reference: nothing it read has changed except the one line below and the PR body, and this record re-derives only those. Read-only git on the committed tree, no checkout, no gate re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. The delta is exactly the ③-1 spelling.** `git diff --stat a7da5b92..684b081c` → one file, +1 −1: `execution-duties.md` L121. Old: 「- 派发词只带增量,⛔ 不整段粘贴卡正文(dev 自读全文与评论);构造细则见 `dispatch-runbook.md`。」 New: 「- 派发词只带增量,⛔ 不整段贴卡正文;dev 自读全文与评论、自查完整(`dispatch-runbook.md`)。」 — byte-for-byte the line the prior record's ③-1 offered, 116 bytes measured on the head. The dropped sub-clause 「并自查正文完整性」 is back as 「自查完整」; increments only, ⛔ no whole-body paste, the dev reading the full card and every comment, and the runbook pointer all remain. L122 「派发词引卡片的精确断言(schema 臂、判据、原文)一律逐字,⛔ 不释义转述。」 is untouched, so the verbatim-quotation allowance still sits beside it. No `#NNN` and no angle bracket on the new line. Correct.

**2. Budgets unchanged.** `execution-duties.md` is 188 lines on the head against the CEILINGS row `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md', 188]` (ratchet L1317; the row moved in line number since the prior record because `main` grew, the value did not); widest line in the file 120 bytes, none over `MAX_LINE_BYTES`; `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row for the file is 0 and no table row is touched. `contract-review.md` 55 lines on the head. `git diff --stat 4c8f40a196..684b081c` is still the same four files, +8 −6; no new path entered the PR.

**3. Merge.** `684b081c` has the single parent `a7da5b92` (tree `3b3607b2d4`), so there is no merge to reproduce. `origin/main` has moved by one commit since the prior record, `4c8f40a196` → `915e9404` (#25489, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/**`, `packages/types/**`, `content/docs/**`, one changeset; nothing under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` or `scripts/pm/**`). The merge-base is still `4c8f40a196`; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 684b081c` → `dd150817cfec7c98ff25202cb1eaac078df802ff`, exit 0, no conflict.

**4. PR body against the tree (closes the prior ③-3).** (a) 「`contract-review.md` 54 → 55 on the merged head, ceiling 60」 and the Line budget row 「55 / 60」 now match the head. (b) `coordinator.md` is written 「(no ceiling row)」 / 「the file carries no CEILINGS row」 — the phantom 49/49 ceiling claim is gone and the file is still net 0 in place. (c) Tier: 「`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` … "MANDATORY", as the claim records)」 — matches the claim; not re-run here, the served tier is the same either way under 「档随面定」. (d) The Gates paragraph now names the head `684b081c` and its ancestry, cites the `a7da5b92` check-runs and record 6370282626 as the record for that head, and lists the body's own local runs on `684b081c` as the author's runs; this record ran nothing locally and treats the head's check-runs as the record (⑤). The Acceptance note on L121 now says the completeness check 「was restored at the reviewer's ③-1 spelling in `684b081c`」 — true on the tree. Correct.

**5. Gates — the head's check-runs are the record.** 42 check-runs on `684b081c`, all `completed` at this write: 29 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed, none pending (eight `Lint · …` / `Type Check · …` jobs were still `in_progress` when the tree reading was taken; re-read every two minutes until none pending). The required floor `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are both `success`; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success`; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (ratchet, id-lint) and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (frame-sync, frame-freshness) are both `success`; the four card-relation checks (claim, single-writer path, same-issue, part-of) are `success` on both of the head's runs. Nothing was built or run locally beyond the trailer check named in Local-runs.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the prior record: `.claude/**` only, `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Closed.** The dropped sub-clause 「并自查正文完整性」 is restored at L121 in the 116-byte spelling the prior record offered (①-1); it landed on this PR, not as a follow-up.
2. **Stands.** `coordinator.md` L13 「维护者指令行改写」 against `project-forms.md` L27 「写下或改写」 — untouched by this delta; recorded, no change demanded.
3. **Closed.** The four body-vs-tree discrepancies (contract-review count, phantom `coordinator.md` ceiling row, tier wording, stale Gates paragraph) are corrected on the body as read at this write (①-4).
4. **Stands.** `user.login` on the PR is still `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note is owed under the new `contract-review.md` L29. The body's attribution block (`github_login` = `os-elon-musk`) remains an HTML comment on the first line with `Fixes #25457` on the third — the same shape as before; recorded, not a FAIL. 「The card this PR closes must claim this branch」 is `success` on this head.
5. **Stands.** Same-account review: card thread, this isolated reviewer and the adopting seat all run under `os-elon-musk`; this record is the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, and the maintainer's standing word in the seat thread of 2026-10-23T14:14Z 「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」 is the ① substitute under the interim line.
6. **Commit trailers.** `684b081c` carries the same model-free trailer pair as the content commit and no card trailer (`check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` over `a7da5b92..684b081c` → ✓, the one local run above); the card relation is the body's `Fixes` line only.

Independence: the diff was produced by the card thread on branch `claude/project-thread-4obil9`; this record is rendered by an isolated subagent and adopted by the `domain:skills` seat 2 session named below.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-4obil9`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`
Reviewed-by-account: `os-elon-musk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对
